    NEW COLLECTION SS26

    Men Women

    Discover the new collection: artisanal passion since 1974

    MODELS OUR BEST SELLERS
    Milano

    The Milano is Mason's extra slim chino, featuring a tapered line, a more comfortable hip and a narrow hem. In SS26 it comes in gabardine, sartorial denim and in the Jogger versions in linen and cotton or Travel & Dynamic fabrics. A model designed for those seeking modern proportions and sartorial rigour in the summer season.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    New York

    The New York is Mason's regular fit chino, defined by a balanced line and a slightly wider leg for natural comfort. In SS26 it comes in stretch gabardine, in the Jogger version in linen and cotton or lyocell and cotton, and in the Icon Flex variant with an elasticated inner waistband. A versatile model that combines proportion, stability and tailored construction.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    Torino

    The Torino is Mason's slim fit chino, defined by a lean line and straight cut that enhances the silhouette. In SS26 it comes in Travel technical satin, in summer versions in linen, cotton and lyocell, as well as in the Flex variant with an elasticated inner waistband. A model that combines everyday elegance with contemporary tailored construction.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    Chile

    The Chile is Mason's iconic cargo, reinterpreted for the summer season across different fits and fabrics. From the extra slim fit in twill and stretch satin to the regular fit in gabardine and denim, through the Jogger version with an elasticated waist and the return of the Chile M74 relaxed – SS26 broadens the offer while maintaining the balance between functionality and sartorial construction.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    New York Carrot

    The New York Carrot is the contemporary evolution of Mason’s iconic model: a chino that combines tailored identity, updated proportions and a modern fit, designed to accompany every occasion of the SS26 season with versatility.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    New York

    The New York is Mason’s iconic model: a versatile chino that combines tailored identity, contemporary proportions and versatility, establishing itself as an evolved essential in the SS26 women’s wardrobe.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    Easy

    Discover the SS26 Mason’s women’s Easy model: available in the Easy Straight, Easy Kick and Easy Jogger versions, crafted in sweatshirt fabric, jersey and lurex. A trouser with evolved comfort and essential lines, designed to combine urban elegance and everyday versatility for Spring Summer 2026.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    Chile

    The Chile is Mason’s essential cargo: an iconic model that combines functionality, utility identity and tailored rigor, reinterpreted in a contemporary key to accompany everyday life of the SS26 season with style and versatility.

    DISCOVER THE MODEL
    Malibu

    Discover the Malibu SS26 Mason’s: a gabardine trouser with carrot fit and slightly dropped crotch, designed to combine dynamic comfort with tailored construction. A relaxed yet defined silhouette, perfect for interpreting Summer 2026 with contemporary urban style.
